description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags are not recaptured in Batch 19. Only explicit inline per-section tags are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Tactical Briefing
sections.description_summary: when Evie gathers intel on every surviving enemy hero without being revealed, she shares the findings with allies. The affected enemies deal reduced damage for the rest of the battle; in non-Boss battles, dispellable debuffs they inflict on allies also have reduced duration. Higher levels increase the reductions and cause enemies to take additional magic damage after the findings are shared.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: after gathering intel on all surviving enemy heroes while concealed, Evie summons an extra quill to follow the ally with the second-highest cumulative damage dealt. Each ally can only be followed by one quill.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: healing an ally increases their ATK for 8 s; higher ranks increase Evie's Healing after the total-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: first ally below 40% HP is healed and shielded; refine grants Healing and Haste.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 15's Ultimate, Pointed Proof, Foretold Favor and Hero Focus capture, this closes the visible ability and progression sections.

sections.name: Malevolent Gaze
sections.description_summary: apostles stun different frontmost enemies, then Lamentis damages all enemies and apostles reduce the max HP of stunned targets. Lamentis and apostles gain ATK SPD after casting.

sections.name: Starcrusher
sections.description_summary: every third normal attack throws an enchanted trident, dealing ATK damage plus target-max-HP-based extra damage with an ATK cap.

sections.name: Astral Fission
sections.description_summary: sacrifices HP to create two apostles that inherit Lamentis's stats, attack his current target and merge back if they survive, healing him based on their actual damage.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases ATK SPD for Lamentis and his apostles; bonus increases with each apostle present.

sections.name: Omnisight
sections.description_summary: apostles gain Growth stacks from normal attacks; their Growth is transferred to Lamentis when they merge. At max Growth, Six Eyes unlocks, allowing free apostle creation and enhanced Starcrusher true damage.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: when an apostle has a stat buff from an ally other than Lamentis, Lamentis gains 10% of that buff.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: increases ATK and Phys & Magic DEF for Lamentis and units he creates; higher ranks add Haste after 5 s.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: normal attacks stack ATK SPD and normal attack damage; refine adds ATK SPD and Execution.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases ATK; summoning Stars adds more ATK up to a cap; converting Stars into Black Holes grants another ATK increase.

sections.name: Starless Hollows
sections.description_summary: after summoning three Stars, permanently converts Stars into Black Holes and devours orbiting Planets. Black Holes deal periodic true damage and target-max-HP-based true damage to nearby enemies.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: expands Gravitic Maw's pull range to 3 tiles. Before converting Stars, Aster gains Energy recovery efficiency; after conversion he ascends and becomes permanently invincible until he is the last surviving hero on his team.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: recovers Energy per second; after three Ultimates, increases ATK. Higher ranks add true damage to all enemies on each Ultimate.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: first Ultimate permanently increases Energy recovery from attacking; Ultimate casts grant temporary damage dealt bonus. Refine adds Haste and Execution.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 15's Ultimate, Gravitic Maw and Darklight Pulse capture, this closes the visible kit.

sections.name: Deflecting Swing
sections.description_summary: reduces damage from a single attack exceeding 10% of Soren's max HP and resets Repel Sweep cooldown; can trigger once every 7 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Haste.

sections.name: Dusk Rejuvenation
sections.description_summary: below 60% HP, grants Haste, HP recovery and Energy recovery for 12 s; higher levels remove control effects and can allow repeated triggers with a cooldown.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: after Deflecting Swing triggers, next Repel Sweep knocks enemies back farther and deals bonus damage based on damage blocked. LV 2 adds Energy, a shield and refreshes Deflecting Swing when knockback collision conditions are met.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken per enemy within 1 tile, up to a cap; higher ranks periodically damage nearby enemies and reduce their ATK.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: opening/assist/defeat grants Penetration and Haste; refine adds Crit Resist, Haste and Ranged DEF.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 17's Ultimate and Repel Sweep capture, this closes the visible kit.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: allied Bulbsprites in giant form are immune to control effects. LV 2 reduces Overgrowth cooldown to 5 s, allows it to affect Smashy, Swifty and Spiny simultaneously, and grants giant allied summons extra ATK.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: increases ATK and Phys & Magic DEF for Florabelle and units she creates; higher ranks add Haste after 5 s.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 s; refine adds Haste and Crit DMG DEF.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 17's Pounding Blow, Overgrowth, Tiny Sharpshooter, Hero Focus and Exclusive Equipment capture, this closes the visible kit.

sections.name: Shock Stomp
sections.description_summary: damages enemies within 1 tile based on Zandrok's max HP and stuns them.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases max HP; adds more max HP while Rallying Roar's temporary buffs are active.

sections.name: Hunter's Fury
sections.description_summary: while above 50% of initial max HP, normal attacks deal extra damage based on max HP. Higher level improves the bonus and empowers the next normal attack of allies inspired by Rallying Roar.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: converts excess healing received into extra max HP, capped at 50% of initial max HP.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken; both bonuses are amplified while on the enemy side. Higher ranks grant a permanent shield on first entry to enemy territory.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 s; refine adds Crit Resist and Haste.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 15's Savage Slash and Rallying Roar capture, this closes the visible kit.

sections.name: Indomitable
sections.description_summary: after the first fatal blow, Brutus becomes immune to all damage and unaffected for 5 s; higher levels grant Life Drain and ATK during immunity.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Life Drain, with an extra bonus when casting Whirlwind Wrath.

sections.name: Cleaving Strike
sections.description_summary: after receiving physical damage 10 times from adjacent enemies, cleaves enemies in a frontal arc for ATK and target-max-HP-based damage, and gains Life Drain. Higher level removes the cooldown limit.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: increases the duration of damage immunity and unaffected status from Indomitable by 1 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken per enemy within 1 tile, up to a cap; higher ranks periodically damage nearby enemies and reduce their ATK.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken at battle start, then increases damage dealt after 20 s; refine adds Life Drain and Crit DMG DEF.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 15's Ultimate and Ferocious Roar capture, this closes the visible kit.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken; the reduction increases every 10 s, stacking up to five times.

sections.name: Chilling Presence
sections.description_summary: at battle start and every 20 s, Alna becomes immune to damage and control. Higher level extends the duration and grants the same immunity to the Winter Warrior; the first time either drops below 50% HP, it triggers automatically for both.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Alna and Winter Warrior gain increased basic stats until one is defeated. The first time either leaves Chilling Presence, nearby enemies are frozen and lose Vitality.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: reduces damage taken per enemy within 1 tile, up to a cap; higher ranks periodically damage nearby enemies and reduce their ATK.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: below 60% HP, reduces damage taken and restores lost HP over 8 s, up to once every 20 s; refine adds Crit Resist and Ranged DEF.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 15's Winter Anthem, Shared Resolve and Wild Whirl capture, this closes the visible kit.

sections.name: Zephyr's Embrace
sections.description_summary: protects the weakest ally for 6 s, granting Dodge, Haste and periodic healing.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Lorsan's ATK; when Stormbound Chain breaks for the first time, he gains an additional ATK bonus.

sections.name: Turbulent Resurgence
sections.description_summary: when Stormbound Chain breaks, heals all allies and casts the chain again, up to three casts per battle. Higher levels improve healing and stun the last linked enemies.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: while Zephyr's Embrace is active, its target becomes unaffected. LV 2 increases chain casts, adds max-HP reduction to transferred damage and grants/extends Zephyr's Embrace on the ally dealing the most damage when the chain breaks.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: opening melee-damage bonus and ranged damage reduction for the ally one tile in front; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: first ally below 40% HP is healed and shielded; refine adds Healing and Assistance.

completed_profiles.completion_note: Together with Batch 16's Whispering Tempest, Stormbound Retribution and Season Charm capture, this closes the visible kit.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: increases Haste; each beat lit adds Haste, and activating her score grants another Haste bonus.

sections.name: Harmonic Refrain
sections.description_summary: when her score is activated, automatically plays it every 8 s, removes dispellable debuffs, restores HP and Energy, and speeds up the score/increases Haste as more beats are collected. Higher level damages nearby enemies based on max HP.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: after the score activates, Tremolo enhances normal attacks with Life Drain and target-max-HP-based true damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken; both bonuses are amplified while on the enemy side. Higher ranks grant a permanent shield on first entry to enemy territory.
